verdict.rationale: Anthropic explicitly states Claude Code skills follow the open Agent Skills standard (agentskills.io) 'which works across multiple AI tools' and describes it as published 'for cross-platform portability,' with the spec itself defining the SKILL.md folder format independently of Claude Code docs. Missing for 10: independent, hands-on evidence that a non-Anthropic tool actually consumes the same SKILL.md folder unmodified.
